subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support allow `updateConfiguration` and explicit preview-field pass-through, and what default plus per-account semantics should `channels.signal.linkPreview` use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but default behavior, linked-device failure handling, container-mode scope, and the untrusted metadata boundary are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in support
options.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields and documents primary-device limitations before enabling `updateConfiguration`.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this open until the related link-preview metadata security issue defines whether OpenClaw may fetch or inject preview metadata.

options.title: Default-on support
options.body: Enable Signal link previews by default while preserving an escape hatch, accepting higher upgrade and security review burden.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in support
recommendation.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields and documents primary-device limitations before enabling `updateConfiguration`.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent Signal send/config/docs history and has already provided public implementation context on this issue.
